name: HOL Guard
description: Blocks risky AI coding agent actions at runtime on your machine — shell commands, secret access, MCP servers, plugins and package installs — against local policy. Apache-2.0 CLI, free on one machine.

skills.name: Policy Lint
skills.description: Checks an agent setup against local policy rules via the hol-guard lint subcommand in the published CLI.

skills.name: Install Doctor
skills.description: Reports on the local install and policy configuration through the hol-guard doctor subcommand.

skills.name: Policy Verify
skills.description: Verifies artifacts and submitted policy through the hol-guard verify and submit subcommands.

skills.name: Secret Scan
skills.description: Scans for secret exposure in agent workflows via the separate hol-guard-secrets console entry point.

skills.name: Policy Eval
skills.description: Runs policy evaluations through the hol-guard-eval console entry point shipped alongside the main CLI.
